::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
India accounts for 18% of NVIDIA's global workforce. Bengaluru and Pune together employ over 2,300 staff focused on GPU software, deep learning, and system software engineering.
:::

## What does this firm design?

GPU architecture and verification, CUDA software stack, AI/ML frameworks, autonomous vehicle computing platforms, and system software for data centre accelerators.
